info.name: Mira API — Complete Bootstrap Routes (2026)
info.description: Generated directly from every mount in bootstraps.ts. Every non-auth mounted module has GET, POST create, POST update (id), DELETE. Auth contains every declared route. Full payload source: postman/mira-crud-sample-data.json. Required images for journey/add-on resources must be sent via multipart/form-data; raw JSON requests show their non-file fields.
